messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: P0 — GPU capacity exhausted in aws-me-south-1. Autoscaler stuck. Pager: lee_oncall
ops-bot: Auto-runbook started: /runbook gpu-quota-exhaustion :rotating_light:
lee_oncall: I'm on it. pulling autoscaler logs now, will triage queue growth.
maria_sre: Queue growth on inference-queue-prod: 18k -> 42k in ~12m. Token p95 latency spiked 4x. Metrics:
```
queue_length: 42_110
pool_utilization: 99.2%
autoscaler_state: PendingQuota
requested_gpus: 104
quota_limit_gpus: 100
```
aj_infra: AWS account quota at 100 GPUs for aws-me-south-1. Requests above are being rejected with InsufficientCapacity/Quota errors. Seeing client-side retries piling up.
sam_reliability: Can we route non-critical traffic to aws-me-north-1 or eu-west fallback? model variants availability check first.
ciara_csm: FYI CS has ~6 customers reporting 503s for hosted inference, 2 on dedicated experiencing degraded throughput. I'm prepping outreach.
lee_oncall: Trying warmpool eviction to free capacity for active inference. Command:
```
# evict warmpool noncritical
redwoodctl pools evict --region aws-me-south-1 --pool warm --label noncritical
```
ops-bot: Warmpool eviction job started (job-id: wp-8421).
maria_sre: Eviction progress: freed 12 GPUs in 90s. Still short ~ (requested 104 vs limit 100). Warmpool free doesn't cover burst.
aj_infra: I've opened AWS support case 987654321: "Limit increase/hardcap inquiry". Ack from support, but ETA ~24-72h. Trying softworkarounds.
sam_reliability: Initiating route-by-policy: diverting low-priority routes to aws-me-north-1. Note: KV cache mismatch risk; we'll accept higher cold-start rates.
lee_oncall: Implemented policy patch: `route.policy.override=low-priority->aws-me-north-1` — will monitor errors. @maria_sre watch for tokenization/kv cache errors.
maria_sre: Saw several 429s from retry storm. Enabling request-coalescing and ramped backoff for retryer.
pm-core: We need a short status update for infra slack and status.redwood.ai; Ciara can you write the customer note?
ciara_csm: Drafting incident notice: short, mentions degraded throughput for hosted inference in aws-me-south-1, mitigation in progress, ETA unknown. Sending to legal/ops for signoff.
cloud-support: AWS responded: quota increases for this account are manual and require full justification; no immediate temporary capacity available. They suggested cross-account tenancy but that's infra heavy.
lee_oncall: Handoff note: I'll be passing oncall to @sam_reliability in 20m. Remaining actions: keep reroutes active, monitor queue, continue CS outreach.
pagerduty-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: lee_oncall -> sam_reliability at 1718801200. Acknowledge with `:thumbsup:`.
deploy-bot: No active deployments in aws-me-south-1 in last 30m. safe to evict warmpools.
aj_infra: Also found a stuck scaleup request loop in autoscaler. Patching autoscaler to stop retrying previously-rejected quota requests to avoid hot-loop.
maria_sre: Started degraded-mode: non-SLA customers will receive 503 quickly to preserve capacity for SLA tenants. Rolling config:
```
service.router.degraded_response_policy = "fail-fast-non-sla"
```
ciara_csm: Sent proactive emails to impacted customers list. Two high-touch customers escalated; handing to solutions for immediate calls.
sam_reliability: I'm oncall now and will lead incident. Current status: queue 32k, pool_util 98.3%, diverted ~28% low-priority traffic. Next update in 15m. Ping me @sam_reliability for urgent escalations.
lee_oncall: Thanks team. Leaving context in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota
ops-bot: Incident timeline recorded. tag: incident/gpu-quota/aws-me-south-1
ciara_csm: Adding customer impact notes to ticket and CS playbook. :white_check_mark:
sam_reliability: reopening AWS case with updated justification, also exploring cross-region cache warmup scripts. Will post follow-ups here.
